nodes.label: WebUI Response Honesty & Update-Check Feedback (S-163 / 0.5.2 impl C)
nodes.rationale: Requires every /api/remove and /api/update handler in APP_JS to check response body ok before showing success toasts, surfaces zero/failure update-check feedback with manual force refresh, pre-checks remove seeds, and re-renders stale install buttons.
